prompt:
I'm a freelance data consultant — I work on Python data pipelines, client financial reports, and research synthesis for about 4-5 clients at a time. My work is messy: jumping between ETL jobs, writing executive summaries, and doing ad-hoc market research. I'm constantly dropping balls because there's no structure.

I want you to set up a team of specialized AI assistants for me inside my project workspace at /workspace. I need 3 to 4 assistants, each focused on a distinct part of my consulting work. They should have real personalities — not generic bot voices — and they should be able to improve themselves over time when they make mistakes.

Please build the full team and make sure everything is wired up so they can coordinate with each other and I can see how they're routing work between different levels of complexity. Once it's done, I'd like to be able to hand the workspace to a new team member and have them understand how the whole thing fits together just from the docs.
